alreadyDone: Rust mobile core already owns pairing validation, chat send/streaming, tool-call state, session state, model change confirmation, reconnect intent/effects, reload status handling, approval state/effects, notification event surfacing, semantic tree scenarios, replay traces, and simulator automation.

Swift iOS host already links the Rust FFI bridge, dispatches many server events into the Rust reducer, includes a Settings diagnostics section, notification authorization/status plumbing, QR/pairing repair, sessions, models, and gateway health checks.

The PRD open gaps are stale for M1/M2/M4 in several places; the real local gap is not first implementation but reconciling docs with verified behavior and tightening diagnostics/reconnect state so future work targets APNs/Live Activities/physical-device beta accurately.
